name: Ben Shelton

observed.title: Carlos Alcaraz vs Ben Shelton Title Battle | Paris 2026 Final Highlights
observed.camera: broadcast (high, wide) plus close-ups between points

appearance.hair: dark brown, wavy, over the headband

forehand.stance: semi-open; holds the racket in front with both hands at chest height while waiting
forehand.takeback: compact, racket low on his left side
forehand.contact: in front at hip height, right arm out for balance
forehand.finish: over the right shoulder, racket head pointing back (left-handed)

backhand.stance: open stance on the run to his right
backhand.takeback: low, racket head below the hands behind the right hip
backhand.contact: beside the front hip, often lunging
backhand.finish: high, both hands up by the left shoulder

running.ready: very wide receiving stance, knees bent
running.splitStep: deep and wide; after his own serve he splits on the service line area as the return is hit (v2 74.6)
running.firstStep: big lean and long driving step toward the ball
running.braking: low lunge on the outside leg (v2 39.8)
running.recovery: settles back into a wide stance quickly

mannerisms: roars with the racket held low after big points (v2 120.0)

gameHints.player-artist: All dark navy kit, white headband, white wristband, white shoes and socks; left-handed, racket in the left hand; colourful racket frame.
gameHints.racket-coach: Left-handed: mirror everything. Forehand: compact low takeback, fast swing, finish over the right shoulder. Backhand (two hands): low takeback, high finish by the left shoulder.
gameHints.animator: Very wide, low receiving stance and a deep split step; long driving first strides; holds the racket in front with both hands between shots.
gameHints.body-animator: Serve: very deep knee bend at the trophy, jumps into the court; recovery split step right after the serve.

notSeen: a close-up of the forehand from the side

serve.trophy: very deep knee bend, racket dropped behind the back
serve.contact: jumps up and into the court at full stretch
serve.speed: 212 km/h on the board at v2 78.5
